scenes.audio: What would happen if you were raised by a billionaire? Day one.
scenes.visual: Transparent glass skeleton baby with large wide eyes sits in luxurious crib with satin sheets, holding large rainbow lollipop; chef in white uniform in grand dining room with crystal chandelier and big windows behind.

scenes.audio: You wake up in a mansion with more rooms than you can count. A private chef brings breakfast to your nursery on a silver platter.
scenes.visual: Same glass skeleton baby in crib as chef presents silver platter of fruit and juice; opulent nursery, gold trim, chandelier, tall curtains; baby reaches for food.

scenes.audio: Your custom crib costs more than most cars. Everything appears before you want it.
scenes.visual: Maid in black/white uniform helps baby into gold-and-marble high chair; second maid opens curtains; warm bright light on reflective surfaces.

scenes.audio: Year ten. You attend the most exclusive private school where everyone's parents are famous.
scenes.visual: Teen glass skeleton in white polo, beige pants, backpack walks through prestigious historic courtyard; students in blazers, security in suits; fountain; bright sun.

scenes.audio: Your dad buys you a real Formula One car modified for kids as a gift.
scenes.visual: Teen skeleton in high-end garage of luxury cars; man in grey suit beside small-scale F1 car; skeleton excited, gesturing; cool overhead light.

scenes.audio: You race it around your private track whenever you want.
scenes.visual: Skeleton in racing suit and helmet driving the F1 car; camera positioned in front of car as it speeds down track; motion blur in background.

scenes.audio: Life feels like pure endless fun.
scenes.visual: Skeleton on golden carousel horse at private fairground; Ferris wheel and mansion behind; smiling as it spins; golden-hour light.

scenes.audio: Year 20. You live in a penthouse throwing massive parties every weekend.
scenes.visual: Adult glass skeleton in patterned shirt dances in crowded high-end penthouse/nightclub; neon blue/pink light; cheering crowd with drinks.

scenes.audio: You buy a new Lamborghini and it arrives the same day.
scenes.visual: Skeleton in aviator sunglasses, smirking, in front of lime-green supercar with scissor doors up; dark sleek garage, spotlight on car.

scenes.audio: You wake up in a different country every week. You've never been happier in your life.
scenes.visual: Skeleton relaxes barefoot in private-jet leather seat holding cocktail; windows show island and turquoise ocean; flight attendant behind.

scenes.audio: Year 30. You're sitting alone in your mansion surrounded by supercars you don't drive.
scenes.visual: On-screen 'Year 30'. Skeleton on high-rise balcony at night over city skyline; lonely, contemplative; grey sweater, gold watch; bokeh city lights.

scenes.audio: Your friends only call when they need something. You've never worked for anything or built something yourself.
scenes.visual: Skeleton on dark leather sofa in dim room staring at phone showing missed calls; whiskey bottle on table; slumped, depressed.

scenes.audio: Year 40. You opened a dog shelter and work there cleaning kennels every day.
scenes.visual: On-screen 'Year 40'. Skeleton at dog shelter in red flannel and brown apron, kneeling, petting golden retriever; family watching; bright kennel room.

scenes.audio: The dogs don't care about your bank account or your last name. You're happier scrubbing floors than you ever were buying mansions.
scenes.visual: Skeleton sits on floor covered by puppies licking and climbing; warm glowing light emanates from its chest.

scenes.audio: You finally found something money can't buy. Purpose.
scenes.visual: Skeleton on wooden porch of building with shelter sign at dusk, petting dog with one hand, holding the rainbow lollipop from the first scene in the other; soft peaceful light.
